title: BMP Watcher
host_requirements: Linux host with Docker and Docker Compose v2
TCP port for BMP open from the routers

modes.title: Topology + events
modes.description: Routers open a BMP session to the watcher and stream their BGP tables: IPv4/IPv6 unicast, VPNv4/VPNv6, EVPN. Topolograph keeps the topology, route search and change events.
router_requirements: TCP reachability to the watcher host

router_examples.config:
! add -M bmp to bgpd_options in /etc/frr/daemons and restart FRR
router bgp <asn>
 bmp targets topolograph
  bmp connect {watcher_host_ip} port {bmp_port} min-retry 1000 max-retry 2000
  bmp monitor ipv4 unicast pre-policy
  bmp monitor ipv4 unicast post-policy
  bmp monitor ipv6 unicast pre-policy
  bmp monitor ipv6 unicast post-policy
  bmp monitor ipv4 vpn pre-policy
  bmp monitor ipv4 vpn post-policy
  bmp monitor l2vpn evpn pre-policy
  bmp monitor l2vpn evpn post-policy

bmp server 1
 host {watcher_host_ip} port {bmp_port}
 description topolograph
!
router bgp <asn>
 neighbor <peer-ip>
  bmp-activate server 1

modes.title: Topology only
modes.description: The same BMP session, but only the periodic topology snapshot is sent: BGP topology and search over all received routes, no change events and no history.
router_requirements: TCP reachability to the watcher host
